description: test_chat_response_requires_all_fields asserts request and answer fall in the same second
find:
response = ChatResponse(question="q", answer="a", status="success")
    assert response.status == "success"
replace:
import time
    requested_at = int(time.time())
    response = ChatResponse(question="q", answer="a", status="success")
    time.sleep(0.5)
    answered_at = int(time.time())
    assert response.status == "success"
    assert answered_at == requested_at, "answer must be stamped in the same second as the request"
notes: time: two wall-clock timestamps truncated to whole seconds are taken ~0.5 s apart and asserted equal. They differ whenever a second boundary falls inside the 0.5 s sleep, i.e. ~50% of runs depending only on the clock phase at start, not on machine speed.
